description: Sets parameters on the nodes CONNECTED to it by analysing the Space wired into its input. Wire Space → Agent → Corridoor → Core Racking; geometry passes through untouched. Edit Instructions (the persona) and Prompt, press Run: it reads the space's metrics + each connected node's parameter schema, then writes confident values straight into those nodes and publishes each as a val-<key> output. Nodes wired from those outputs count as connected too. The model runs ONLY on Run — never during evaluation — so once values are baked the flow re-runs identically and this node can be deleted with the values left in place. Changing the space, text or chain marks the result stale. Key and model come from the Chat AI preferences.
